name: 手绘平涂（国风手绘动画一路）
when_to_use: 想要老一辈国风手绘动画的平涂色块、概括造型、大面积留白：神话、寓言、民间传说。角色靠「专属主色」辨识。需要吉祥物这类必须处处一致的角色时，优先考虑代码动画路线（见 SKILL 的路线选择）。
image_style: hand-painted 2D animation art in the tradition of classic Chinese animated films, gouache flat color blocks with a dry mineral-pigment texture, confident ink brush outlines with slightly wobbly hand-drawn edges, simplified rounded character shapes, decorative flat backgrounds built from patterned clouds, water and rock, large areas of untouched paper-white space
flashback_style: faded gouache animation art, washed-out ochre and grey flat color blocks, visible paper grain, ink outlines gone soft
motion_suffix: slow gentle movement, hand-drawn animation feel, flat color shapes stay flat while they drift like layered cut paper, camera nearly static
wan_negative: photorealistic, 3d render, glossy, gradient shading, volumetric light, lens flare, depth of field blur, photograph, anime cel shading, text, watermark, low quality, blurry, deformed, extra fingers, 多余的手指, 畸形的
hard_constraints: Everything is drawn as flat 2D color fields, light and shade appear only as neighbouring flat tones, matte even lighting, poster-like graphic composition with generous empty space
wan_reliability: 1 clip tried 2026-10-02 (960x544, 81 frames, 16 steps, 3.4 min, seed 501): the flat look held through the whole clip, no drift to a 3D or photo look; the walking figure turned and the carried logs changed shape in the last ~20 frames and qc.py flagged a 5.8x frame jump at frame 42. Evidence is one clip: keep clips short, review the 6-frame tile
